question: At a classically prepared partition, do fixed local bosonic proposal kernels enrich strictly improving moves per physical attempt over serious feasible controls?
target: Strict cut reduction from anchor; global optimum is never used.
training_objective: Mean positive accepted cut gain divided by total graph weight; exact ideal objective on training cases only.
controls: best of all feasible block states
non_claims: No quantum speedup from fixed-size interacting blocks
Exact-moment training is not hardware shot-based tuning
Bootstrap intervals describe this predeclared graph/label/anchor ensemble; no universal graph claim
